name: C074 Kẻ Dệt Thời Gian (Quyền Trượng Đồng Hồ Cát Thời Không)
prompt_ref:
Create a single-cell 1x1 reference sheet of an Epic dark-fantasy Time Weaver's chronos hourglass staff (Quyền Trượng Đồng Hồ Cát Thời Không - C074 Kẻ Dệt Thời Gian) following the exact square cell of the attached reference layout_guide_1x1.png.

COMPOSITION & ORIENTATION (100% MANDATORY):
- Draw ONE complete chronomancer staff oriented DIAGONALLY from bottom-left (bronze clockwork shaft) to top-right (an intricate golden clockwork halo and celestial gear frame enclosing a crystalline hourglass filled with glowing cyan-and-gold temporal sand).
- Must show 100% of the entire staff from bottom tip to top clockwork hourglass head with generous padding inside the frame (occupying 65%-75% of the canvas).
- Zero clipping at canvas edges.

COLOR & BACKGROUND (100% MANDATORY):
- Background MUST be flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) edge-to-edge.
- DO NOT use any magenta/pink tones on the staff itself (use antique brass, celestial gold, dark gunmetal gears, and luminous cyan-turqoise & gold time-sand).
- No character hands, no text, no borders.
prompt_anim_2x2:
Create a 2x2 sprite sheet (4 frames total: row 1 left-to-right, row 2 left-to-right) of the EXACT SAME Chronos Hourglass Staff from the first attached reference image, following the 2x2 grid layout of the second attached reference image (layout_guide_2x2.png).

100% CONSISTENCY & ANIMATION RULES:
- Every cell must show the exact same diagonal clockwork hourglass staff at the exact same angle, size, and position.
- Animate a looping 4-frame temporal acceleration aura: glowing cyan-and-gold Roman clock numerals, swirling golden time-sand ribbons, and shimmering chronos rings orbiting the hourglass head.
- Background MUST be flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) in all 4 cells. DO NOT draw the blue layout guide lines or cell borders. Keep each frame strictly inside its cell with zero clipping.
prompt_card:
Create a wide horizontal 16:11 dark-fantasy card illustration featuring the exact same Chronos Hourglass Staff (Quyền Trượng Đồng Hồ Cát Thời Không - C074 Kẻ Dệt Thời Gian) from the attached reference images.

COMPOSITION & BACKGROUND (100% MANDATORY):
- Place the golden clockwork hourglass staff diagonally across the center of the horizontal frame.
- Full atmospheric dark-fantasy background (100% opaque RGB illustration, NO magenta, NO transparency): a timeless astral clock-tower chamber where glowing cyan-and-gold temporal gears and streams of golden time-sand warp reality around the staff.
- Do NOT draw any card frame, borders, or text.
